items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: everybody told me I sing like Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: That's very interesting. But of course, your style was very different than Mamie Smith's. You used your own style
(Unintelligible) that was the main thing he told me back there (unintelligible) he said, you sing just like Bessie Smith.

items.q: this other gal ________ Aunt Jemima. He tried ________. He said, "But Sippy, she can't sing like you."

ctx.x: can do because these women nowadays, they no good. They laugh in your face, they'll try to steal your man. Now, woman, be wise, keep your mouth shut and don't advertise your man. Don't be no fool, don't advertise your man.

And so when I sang it to Buddy, Buddy (unintelligible). I said, (unintelligible), but they didn't give me time to make it ________, you know. Because I had to think of something right now.
